title: bacnet-interop fixture provenance
description:
Provenance metadata for a BACnet corpus fixture (golden packet and/or semantic sidecar).

Authoring rules:
- Every committed fixture must appear in fixtures/manifest.json.
- Prefer independently-generated vectors; sanitize captures before commit.
- Never commit credentials, live site identifiers, or uncleared vendor captures.
- Set expect.* flags honestly: original_bytes_equal is strict and rare.
- Adapters and go-bacnet assertions consume these fields; do not invent undocumented status values.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

id.description: Stable kebab-case fixture identifier. Must be unique within the manifest.

description.description: One-line summary of what this fixture exercises.

source.description: Implementation that produced or inspired the bytes.

capture.description: How and where the bytes were obtained or constructed.

standard.description: Normative baseline this fixture is intended to exercise.

input_hex.description: Optional even-length hex encoding of the wire input (two chars per byte). Prefer lowercase in new fixtures.

semantic_file.description: Optional path (relative to the repository root) to a JSON/YAML semantic sidecar describing the expected decode structure.

operation.description: Executable consumer operation name (e.g. decode_read_property_ack). Required with expected/expected_error when semantic_decode_equal is true and no semantic_file is provided.

expected.description: Machine-readable successful decode expectations for operation.

notes.description: Author notes: intentional non-canonical encodings, known peer quirks, or why a given expect flag is false.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering (bvlc, npdu, apdu, discovery, cov, …).

implementation.description: Peer or generator name (e.g. bacnet-stack, bacpypes3, otfabric-handwritten, wireshark-export).

version.description: Upstream version, git describe, or generator revision. Use 'n/a' only for pure handwritten vectors with no peer binary.

image_digest.description: Container image digest used when the fixture was produced (sha256:…), or 'none' when not produced from an adapter image.

direction.description: Traffic direction relative to the logical client/server roles, or constructed/unknown for synthetic vectors.

transport.description: Link/transport context. Horizon 1 fixtures are typically bacnet-ip-udp or virtual/constructed.

original_endpoint.description: Sanitized endpoint label (host:port, device instance, or 'lab-synthetic'). Must not include customer or site-identifying hostnames.

base.description: Normative baseline identifier, e.g. ANSI/ASHRAE 135-2024 (protocol revision 31).

protocol_revision.description: Optional BACnet protocol_revision integer when relevant.

clauses.description: Optional clause or annex references aiding TRACEABILITY.md mapping.

semantic_decode_equal.description: When true, decoded semantics must match the declared semantic sidecar / structure.

deterministic_reencode_equal.description: When true, encoding the decoded value must match a deterministic canonical encoding (not necessarily the original capture bytes).

original_bytes_equal.description: When true, round-trip must preserve input_hex exactly. Use only when the capture is already canonical or when testing byte-identity deliberately.

status.description:
Origin / redistribution class.
- independently-generated: written or regenerated by OT Fabric without copying peer source
- capture: sanitized lab/pcap extract
- malformed-constructed: deliberately invalid for negative tests
- standards-boundary: exercises a standards edge case or interpretation
- vendor-restricted: must not be redistributed publicly; keep out of public clones

notes.description: Optional clarification (e.g. capture sanitized on date, why vendor-restricted).

examples.description: Minimal BVLC Original-Unicast-NPDU header for length parsing
